crossAuditRationale: The validation sentence needs feminine agreement with कुंजी. Retain the source API acronym; the proposed wording communicates the required key.
selectedTarget: आपको API कुंजी प्रदान करनी होगी।

crossAuditRationale: This is a Traditional Chinese validation message. The current target uses Simplified forms; the proposed Traditional forms preserve the API literal and required-key meaning.
preimageTarget: 您必须提供 API 键
selectedTarget: 您必須提供 API 金鑰

crossAuditRationale: The source requires a valid URL. The current wording says a URL value; the proposed wording states validity while preserving URL.
preimageTarget: Bạn phải cung cấp một giá trị URL
selectedTarget: Bạn phải cung cấp một URL hợp lệ.

crossAuditRationale: The current transliteration of trailing slash reads awkwardly. The proposed Korean states that no slash may appear at the URL end.
preimageTarget: URL은 트레일 슬래시에서 끝나지 않아야 합니다.
selectedTarget: URL 끝에 슬래시가 있어서는 안 됩니다.

crossAuditRationale: The current wording repeats the end-position idea with diakhiri and di akhir. The shorter wording keeps the prohibition and URL literal.
preimageTarget: URL tidak boleh diakhiri dengan garis miring di akhir.
selectedTarget: URL tidak boleh diakhiri dengan garis miring.

crossAuditRationale: The validation message requires either alternative to be valid. The current wording omits the article before dirección IP and leaves the modifier scope unclear; the proposal makes both alternatives explicit.
preimageTarget: Usted debe proporcionar un nombre de host válido o dirección IP
selectedTarget: Debe proporcionar un nombre de host válido o una dirección IP válida.

crossAuditRationale: The current Hindi transliterates IP, while the source literal must remain IP. The proposal keeps the hostname-or-IP requirement and preserves the exact acronym.
preimageTarget: आपको वैध होस्टनाम या आईपी एड्रेस प्रदान करना होगा
selectedTarget: आपको मान्य होस्टनाम या IP पता प्रदान करना होगा।

crossAuditRationale: The source distinguishes a hostname from an IP address. The current target says host address; the proposal makes both alternatives clear.
preimageTarget: Anda mesti memberikan alamat host atau IP yang valid
selectedTarget: Anda mesti memberikan nama host atau alamat IP yang valid.

crossAuditRationale: The label transliterates the protected API literal. The proposal retains API and translates Key.
French typography places a space before the colon. The breadcrumb wording and menu path stay the same.
preimageTarget: Trouvez-le dans Lidarr: Paramètres > Général > Sécurité > Clé API
selectedTarget: Trouvez-le dans Lidarr : Paramètres > Général > Sécurité > Clé API

crossAuditRationale: The current Korean breadcrumb has an unnecessary space before the colon. The proposal removes only that spacing.
preimageTarget: Lidarr에서 찾기 : 설정 > 일반 > 보안 > API 키
selectedTarget: Lidarr에서 찾기: 설정 > 일반 > 보안 > API 키

crossAuditRationale: The source literal URL is transliterated in the current target. The proposal restores URL and preserves Lidarr, the /lidarr example, and the instruction to leave the field blank otherwise.
preimageTarget: यदि आप Lidarr (सेटिंग्स > जनरल > होस्ट) में यूआरएल बेस सेट करते हैं, तो इसे यहां दर्ज करें (उदाहरण के लिए /lidarr)। अन्यथा खाली छोड़ दें.
selectedTarget: यदि आप Lidarr में URL बेस सेट करते हैं (सेटिंग्स > सामान्य > होस्ट), तो इसे यहाँ दर्ज करें (उदाहरण: /lidarr)। अन्यथा खाली छोड़ दें।
